d_customer.name: d_customer
d_customer.sql:
select
    customer_id,
    customer_nm,
    coalesce(customer_segment, 'UNKNOWN') as customer_segment,
    created_dt
from {{ source('bronze', 'customers_raw') }}

city_nm.description: City of the order, upper case.

customer_segment.description: Segment of the customer who placed the order.

f_sales.name: f_sales
f_sales.sql:
select
    o.order_dt                    as sale_dt,
    o.city_nm,
    o.region_cd,
    c.customer_segment,
    count(distinct o.order_id)    as order_cnt,
    sum(o.gross_amt)              as net_revenue_amt
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} o
join {{ ref('d_customer') }} c
  on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

stg_orders.name: stg_orders
stg_orders.sql:
select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    cast(order_dt as date)        as order_dt,
    upper(trim(city_nm))          as city_nm,
    region_cd,
    order_status,
    cast(gross_amt as decimal(18,2))    as gross_amt,
    cast(discount_amt as decimal(18,2)) as discount_amt
from {{ source('bronze', 'orders_raw') }}
